headline_pain: Not Sure About Tax on New Builds?
primary_text: "I heard you get better tax deductions buying new but my accountant hasn't explained it properly." You shouldn't have to be a tax expert to make a smart property decision. That's why we connect every buyer with a qualified quantity surveyor who prepares a depreciation schedule specific to your Truganina warehouse. You'll see exactly what you can claim, year by year, before you commit. Brand-new construction means full Division 43 building write-offs plus Division 40 plant and equipment deductions. It's one of the most overlooked advantages of buying off-the-plan. Get the depreciation estimate and let the numbers speak for themselves.
description: Qualified quantity surveyor provides your depreciation schedule before purchase
